ROUND(number, [decimal_places])
Returns a number rounded to the specified number of decimal places.
Parameters
number: The number to round.
decimal_places: Optional. The number of decimal places to round to. Defaults
to 0. Can be positive or negative.
Returns
The rounded number.
Example
You could use the following expression in a view to limit the precision of the /price
field of the source topic to 2 decimal places.
ROUND(/price, 2) AS /price
